correctness.rationale: The final theorem gives nu_p gcd_{2<=q<=k+1} C(qk,k)=max(0,a-floor(log_p((k+1)/p^a))) for each p^a||(k+1), with no other primes. All-q Kummer lower bound uses low carry positions j<=a and disjoint high positions a+t<j<=a+nu_p(q-1); the q=1+p^a s witness uses an exact factorial-valuation identity and t Kummer carries. Prime-support/zero branch is explicitly dependent on Guo et al. Lemmas 4 and 9. Direct independent integer gcd calculation corroborated k=2..120 (119 cases), not an infinite proof.
